title: Closed embedding of rank-two Donaldson–Uhlenbeck–Yau moduli from the projective plane into a very general genus-two K3 double cover
source_title: The geometry of antisymplectic involutions, II
author: Laure Flapan; Emanuele Macrì; Kieran G. O’Grady; Giulia Saccà
difficulty_reason: Properness and injectivity of pullback do not by themselves give a closed embedding at the singular Donaldson–Uhlenbeck–Yau strata. The authors construct a new explicit ramified matrix lift, prove invariant-ring surjectivity from the complete lifted trace/scalar-product generators, and control the resulting fixed analytic germs and normality. Their full local moduli/formality/quiver analysis then supports the normality-and-Zariski-Main closing step, rather than leaving the singular-stratum obligation as background.

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Theorem2.13 under Section2.3: genus-two polarized K3 surface S with NS(S)=Zh, double cover f:S to P2 ramified on a very general smooth sextic, and n divisible by4. Exact rank-two Chern/Mukai vectors u_n and v_n of Sections2.1/2.2. Pullback embeds the corresponding Donaldson–Uhlenbeck–Yau compactification Mbar_(P2,n) into Mbar_(S,n), with image an irreducible component of the reduced fixed locus of the covering-induced involution. Full authored local new ramified matrix lift19–21, normality22–24 and closing theorem24 read; Bridgeland/quiver local models7–16 included. Named published formality, moduli existence, Procesi invariant generators, Crawley–Boevey moment-map normality and Zariski Main Theorem traced. The displayed intermediate inequality on physical13 has a summation-placement slip; the stated p(beta) formulas and nonzero summand dimension hypotheses explicitly give the elementary required strict inequality, without a new mathematical construction. The later Fano/positive-component main outcomes are not selected: although read25–31, their extension/fixed-sheaf identification requires further source clarification; no assistant repair supplied. Whole44-page context retained with JEP13(2026), DOI10.5802/jep.337, exact PDF authors and individualCCBY4 license.
